goal.title: Make a cool website
goal.pitch: Build a complete personal portfolio website from a single description.

checks.name: site
checks.command: npm run build && npm run check:site

checks.name: ui-build
checks.command: npm --prefix swarm-ui ci --no-audit --no-fund && npm --prefix swarm-ui run build

targets.name: Generator
targets.description: scripts/build.mjs: turns the single description.md into the site. Owns what a description can express (sections, projects, links, images, metadata) and how forgiving the parser is.

targets.name: Portfolio site
targets.description: The built portfolio in dist/: layout, typography, theming, responsiveness, accessibility and performance of the page a visitor sees.

project.name: My Test Website Proj
project.tagline: A portfolio website, built from one description.
